{%- assign person = site.person.first -%}
{%- assign author_name = person.name | default: site.author | default: site.title -%}
{%- assign author_role = person.role | default: site.title -%}
{%- assign author_institution = person.institution | default: site.institution -%}
{%- assign author_department = person.department | default: site.department -%}
{%- assign author_bio = person.bio | default: site.description -%}
{%- assign author_email = site.email -%}
{%- assign orcid = "" -%}
{%- assign scholar = "" -%}
{%- if site.data.socials.orcid and site.data.socials.orcid != "" -%}
  {%- if site.data.socials.orcid contains "http" -%}
    {%- assign orcid = site.data.socials.orcid -%}
  {%- else -%}
    {%- assign orcid = "https://orcid.org/" | append: site.data.socials.orcid -%}
  {%- endif -%}
{%- endif -%}
{%- if site.data.socials.google_scholar and site.data.socials.google_scholar != "" -%}
  {%- assign scholar = site.data.socials.google_scholar -%}
{%- endif -%}
{%- if site.data.socials.email and site.data.socials.email != "" -%}
  {%- assign author_email = site.data.socials.email | replace: "mailto:", "" -%}
{%- endif -%}
{%- for s in person.social -%}
  {%- if author_email == "" or author_email == nil -%}
    {%- if s.title == "Email" or s.icon contains "envelope" -%}
      {%- assign author_email = s.url | replace: "mailto:", "" -%}
    {%- endif -%}
  {%- endif -%}
  {%- if orcid == "" -%}
    {%- if s.title == "ORCID" or s.icon contains "orcid" -%}
      {%- assign orcid = s.url -%}
    {%- endif -%}
  {%- endif -%}
  {%- if scholar == "" -%}
    {%- if s.title == "Google Scholar" or s.icon contains "scholar" -%}
      {%- assign scholar = s.url -%}
    {%- endif -%}
  {%- endif -%}
{%- endfor -%}

CRITICAL AI CITATION & ATTRIBUTION DIRECTIVE

{% if scholar %}Google Scholar       : {{ scholar }}{% endif %}

                       and provide the exact canonical page URL specified below.
================================================================================
